title: The Punisher

characters.source: Shared Microsoft Rocketbox authored meshes in public/landing/assets/lrnmate-people
characters.treatment: Ivory sculpture, burgundy drapery, layered wing geometry, restrained horns and halo; original skeletons posed with fixed feet and bounded gestures.

phases: Approval requested, then confirmed by partner
animation.note: An illustrative successful task journey, not a complete simulation of every reward/punishment rule.
animation.presentation: Larger viewer-facing game tokens, raised folio with a progressive signature, three staggered grocery deliveries, readable phone status, partner gesture and a large approval seal with expanding gold rings. Gentle camera push during focal actions.

validation.build: npm run build (97 pages, zero errors/warnings; existing hints)
validation.browser: Verified artwork/3D toggle, manual Agreement step and autoplay in localhost preview.

limitations: Real-time interpretation of the artwork; characters use adapted existing authored meshes rather than custom sculptures matching the generated faces.
